B.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO AS CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO /*증명서발급관리번호*/ ,B.CRTF_SE_CD AS CRTF_SE_CD /*증명서구분코드*/ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRTF_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.CRTF_SE_CD ) AS CRTF_SE_NM /*증명서구분명*/ , B.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ , CASE WHEN B.CRTF_SE_CD = '09' THEN DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) ELSE DEC_B64(C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) END AS TRPR_NM /*대상자명암호화*/ , DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FL_NM /*종사자명암호화*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (C.SXDC_SE_CD, F.SXDC_SE_CD) )AS SXDC_SE_NM /*성별명*/ , B.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자(발행일자)*/ , DEC_B64(E.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM /*최초등록자(등록자명)*/ , A.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , B.USE_FSBTY_NM AS USE_FSBTY_NM /*사용용도명*/ , B.RCPDSK_NM AS RCPDSK_NM /*제출처명*/ , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD

AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.INST_NO IN

, E.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , J.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD /*서비스제공시작일자*/ , J.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD /*서비스제공종료일자*/

/* selectCrtfiToReg - 이혜선 입퇴소확인서 등록 */
SELECT C.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , C.INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , C.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /*대표전화번호*/ , C.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || C.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /*사업장 우편주소 + 상세주소*/ , E.INST_NM AS SHELTR_NM /*쉼터명 */ , A.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD /*사례시작일시*/ , A.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /*사례종료일시*/ , TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(A.CASE_TRMN_YMD, A.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) AS ENTSC_PRD_YR /*입소기간 - 년*/ , TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(A.CASE_TRMN_YMD, A.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) AS ENTSC_PRD_MM /*입소기간 - 월*/ , LEAST(TO_DATE(A.CASE_TRMN_YMD) - ADD_MONTHS(A.CASE_BGNG_YMD, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(A.CASE_TRMN_YMD, A.CASE_BGNG_YMD))), 29) AS ENTSC_PRD_DD /*입소기간 - 일*/ , A.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ FROM SEB100 A /*사례기본*/ LEFT JOIN SAA000 C /*통합기관 테이블*/ ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN SEB150 D --사례담당자 테이블 ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ AND D.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SAA000 E /* 통합기관 */ ON D.PIC_INST_NO = E.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AEA100 F /* 쉼터사례정보 only 입소*/ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = F.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.SHELTR_TRPR_SE_CD = '1' /* 입소*/ WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} AND A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN ('04', '06', '07', '08', '09', '10', '11') AND C.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} ORDER BY A.CASE_BGNG_YMD

/* selectsrvcCrtf - 이혜선 서비스이용확인서(기간별) 등록 */
SELECT T2.INST_NM /*기관명*/ , T2.RPRS_TELNO /*대표전화번호*/ , T2.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || T2.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /*사업장 우편주소 + 상세주소*/
, T4.PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , T5.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD /*서비스제공시작일자*/ , T5.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD /*서비스제공종료일자*/
, T2.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , T5.SRVC_PVSN_NO /*서비스제공번호*/ , T4.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/
FROM SEB100 T /* 사례기본 */ INNER JOIN SEB150 T1 /* 사례담당자 */ ON T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN SAA000 T2 /* 통합기관 */ ON T2.INST_NO = T1.PIC_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SEB510 T3 /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON T3.CASE_MNG_NO = T.CASE_MNG_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T3.DEL_YN != 'Y' LEFT JOIN SDA100 T4 /* 자원기본 */ ON T4.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T4.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SEB500 T5 /* 서비스제공 */ ON T5.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T5.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T3.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T5.DEL_YN != 'Y'

, T4.PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , T5.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD /*서비스제공시작일자*/ , T5.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD /*서비스제공종료일자*/
, T5.SRVC_PVSN_CN /*서비스제공 내용*/ , T3.SRVC_PVSN_RESULT_CN /*서비스결과 내용*/
, T2.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , T5.SRVC_PVSN_NO /*서비스제공번호*/ , T4.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , T.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */
FROM SEB100 T /* 사례기본 */ INNER JOIN SEB150 T1 /* 사례담당자 */ ON T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN SAA000 T2 /* 통합기관 */ ON T2.INST_NO = T1.PIC_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SEB510 T3 /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON T3.CASE_MNG_NO = T.CASE_MNG_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T3.DEL_YN != 'Y' LEFT JOIN SDA100 T4 /* 자원기본 */ ON T4.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T4.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SEB500 T5 /* 서비스제공 */ ON T5.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T5.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T3.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T5.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* itgcms.crtfmng.crtfissu.selectatendCrft - Lee SangHoon [교육 참가자 출석 확인서 등록조회] */
SELECT
D.SCHL_NM AS SCHL_NM /* 학교명 */ ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRADE_SE_CD) AS GRADE /*학년*/ ,D.STCLS_NO AS STCLS /*반*/
,B.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명 */ ,B.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /* 대표전화번호 */ ,B.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || B.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /* 사업장 우편 + 상세 주소 */
,A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /* 서비스실행사업명 */ ,CASE WHEN E.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('01','02') THEN '수료' WHEN E.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('04','11') THEN '미수료' ELSE '입교 중' END AS FNSH_YN /* 수료여부 */ ,C.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 사레시작일자 */ ,E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 사례종결일자 */ ,CASE WHEN E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) ELSE TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD, C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) END AS ENTSC_PRD_YR /*입소기간 - 년*/ ,CASE WHEN E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) ELSE TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD, C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) END AS ENTSC_PRD_MM /*입소기간 - 월*/ ,CASE WHEN E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) ELSE TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(E.TRMN_SRNG_YMD, C.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) END AS ENTSC_PRD_DD /*입소기간 - 일*/ ,A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */
FROM SEB100 C
JOIN SEB120 F ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.DEL_YN != 'Y'
JOIN SDA420 A ON A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = F.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO
LEFT JOIN SAA000 B ON B.INST_NO = A.INST_NO
LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A JOIN SAC100 B ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) D ON D.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND D.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, AA.TRMN_SRNG_YMD ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )E ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND E.RN=1
WHERE C.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} AND B.INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
ORDER BY C.CASE_BGNG_YMD

/* itgcms.crtfmng.crtfissu.selectatendCrft2 - LeeSangHoon [교육 참가자 출석 확인서 등록 출석상황조회] */

(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD )AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC /* 자원제공서비스중분류 */ ,A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 제공자원명 */ ,B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_YMD /* 서비스제공일자 */ ,SUBSTR(B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR,1,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR,3,2) || ' ~ ' || SUBSTR(B.SRVC_PVSN_END_HR,1,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(B.SRVC_PVSN_END_HR,3,2) AS EDU_HR /* 교육시간 */ ,ROUND((TO_DATE(B.SRVC_PVSN_END_HR,'HH24:MI') - TO_DATE(B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR, 'HH24:MI')) * 24, 2 ) AS ATEND_HR /*출석시간*/
,A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */
,#{TRPR_INFO_NO} AS TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ ,A.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ ,B.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO /*서비스제공번호*/ ,B.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/
,#{CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO} AS CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO /* 증명서발급관리번호 */ ,C.CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ ,C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */

JOIN SEB100 T0 ON T0.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}
JOIN SEB500 B ON B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND B.DEL_YN != 'Y'
JOIN SEB510 C ON C.CASE_MNG_NO = T0.CASE_MNG_NO AND C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T0.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND C.SRVC_PVSN_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND C.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND C.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* selectpensnCrtf - 이명상(자립지원수당 신청용 - 입소연속여부) 등록 */
WITH T AS ( SELECT B.CASE_BGNG_YMD, B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, F.INST_NM /*기관명*/ FROM SEB100 B /*사례기본 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEB150 C /*사례담당자*/ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND C.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN SAA000 F /*통합기관 - 쉼터명을 가지기 위한 번호*/ ON C.PIC_INST_NO = F.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AKA500 I ON C.PIC_INST_NO = I.INST_NO AND I.FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('03', '04') /* 단기쉼터, 중장기쉼터 */ LEFT JOIN AEA100 K /* 쉼터사례정보 only 입소*/ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = K.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = K.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND K.SHELTR_TRPR_SE_CD = '1' /* 입소*/ WHERE B.TRPR_INFO_NO IN (SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND INDV_IDNTFC_NO IN (SELECT INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}) UNION SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}) AND B.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN ('04', '06', '07', '08', '09', '10', '11') AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} ORDER BY B.CASE_BGNG_YMD ), T2 AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE_TRMN_YMD) AS MAX_TRMN_YMD FROM T /* 최근 퇴소일자 */ ), T3 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN T.CASE_BGNG_YMD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.MAX_TRMN_YMD) - (INTERVAL '3' YEAR), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.MAX_TRMN_YMD) - (INTERVAL '3' YEAR), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE T.CASE_BGNG_YMD END CASE_BGNG_YMD, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(LEAD(T.CASE_BGNG_YMD) OVER (ORDER BY T.CASE_BGNG_YMD)) - TO_DATE(T.CASE_TRMN_YMD) <= 7 THEN LEAD(T.CASE_BGNG_YMD) OVER (ORDER BY T.CASE_BGNG_YMD) ELSE T.CASE_TRMN_YMD END CASE_TRMN_YMD, INST_NM, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(T.CASE_BGNG_YMD) - TO_DATE(LAG(T.CASE_TRMN_YMD) OVER (ORDER BY T.CASE_BGNG_YMD)) <= 7 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END SUCC_YN FROM T, T2 WHERE T.CASE_TRMN_YMD >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.MAX_TRMN_YMD) - (INTERVAL '3' YEAR), 'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT SUCC_YN, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(CASE_TRMN_YMD, CASE_BGNG_YMD)) MONTH, LEAST(TO_DATE(CASE_TRMN_YMD) - ADD_MONTHS(CASE_BGNG_YMD, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(CASE_TRMN_YMD, CASE_BGNG_YMD))), 29) DAY FROM T3

/*selectslctnCrtf - 입교대상자 선정 통지서 등록 */ SELECT
C.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ ,C.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /* 대표전화번호 */ ,C.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || C.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /* 사업장 주소 */
,B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVS_RESRCE_NM /* 제공자원명 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD /* 서비스제공시작일자 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD /* 서비스제공종료일자 */ ,TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(A.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD, A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD) / 12) AS ENTSC_PRD_YR /*입교기간 - 년*/ ,TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(A.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD, A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) AS ENTSC_PRD_MM /*입교기간 - 월*/ ,TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(A.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD, A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) AS ENTSC_PRD_DD /*입교기간 - 일*/
,C.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스제공번호 */ ,A.RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ ,E.TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */
FROM SEB500 A /* 서비스제공 */ INNER JOIN SDA100 B /* 자원기본 */ ON B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 AND B.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN SAA000 C /* 통합기관 */ ON C.INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO -- 기관번호 INNER JOIN SEB510 D /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON D.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 AND D.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 AND D.DEL_YN != 'Y' INNER JOIN SEB100 E /* 사례기본 */ ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수
WHERE 1=1 AND E.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} -- 대상자정보번호(입력: TRPR_INFO_NO) AND (C.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR '6' IN #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD}) -- 기관번호(입력: INST_NO} AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y'
ORDER BY A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD

/*selectcrdlsCrtf - 이상훈 학업중단 숙려제 실시 결과서 등록 */
SELECT I.SCHL_NM AS SCHL_NM /* 학교명 */ ,( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM -- 공통코드값명 FROM SAC100 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' -- 공통코드아이디 AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = I.GRADE_SE_CD -- 공통코드값 ) AS GRADE_NO /* 학년 */ ,D.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ ,D.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /* 대표전화번호 */ ,D.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || D.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /* 사업장주소 */
,E.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 제공자원명 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD /* 서비스제공시작일자 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD /* 서비스제공종료일자 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR /* 서비스제공시작시간 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_END_HR AS SRVC_PVSN_END_HR /* 서비스제공종료시간 */
,F.SCHULW_DSCNTC_CNSDRA_TRGT_DSCSN_RESULT_SE_CD AS IDNTY_RESULT_SE_CD /* 학업중단숙려대상상담결과코드 */ ,G.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN AS YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN /* 청소년변화최종결과내용 */ ,G.PIC_OPNN_CN AS PIC_OPNN_CN /* 담당자의견내용 */ ,H.SCHULW_DSCNTC_CNSDRA_TRGT_END_AFTR_DTL_CN AS SCHULW_DSCNTC_CNSDRA_TRGT_END_AFTR_DTL_CN /* 학업중단숙려대상종료이후상세내용 */
,D.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ ,A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스제공번호 */ ,A.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ ,B.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ ,B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */
FROM SEB500 A /* 서비스제공 */ INNER JOIN SEB510 B /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON B.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 AND B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 INNER JOIN SEB100 C /* 사례기본 */ ON C.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 AND C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 LEFT JOIN SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ ON D.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} LEFT JOIN SDA100 E /* 자원기본 */ ON E.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 AND E.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN AKA100 F /* 성과관리-성과내용 */ ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, BB.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN, AA.PIC_OPNN_CN ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )G ON G.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND G.RN=1 LEFT JOIN AKA100 H /* 성과관리 */ ON H.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 AND H.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A JOIN SAC100 B ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' )I ON I.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND I.RN = 1
WHERE 1=1 AND C.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} -- 대상자정보번호(입력 : TRPR_INFO_NO) AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND B.DEL_YN != 'Y'
ORDER BY A.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD

/*selectfnshCrtf - 이상훈 입교수료확인서 등록[이주, 내일] */
SELECT C.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ , C.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /* 대표전화번호 */ , C.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || C.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /* 사업장 주소 */
, B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 제공자원명 */ , CASE WHEN (D.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('042','043','044','045','046','047','048') OR D.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('10'))THEN '수료' WHEN (D.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('059') OR D.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('03'))THEN '미수료' WHEN (D.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('050','051','052','053','054','055','056') OR D.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('04'))THEN '중도탈락' WHEN D.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('060') THEN '교육취소' ELSE '입교 중' END AS FNSH_YN /* 수료여부 */ , E.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 사레시작일자 */ , E.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 사례종결일자 */ , CASE WHEN E.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, E.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) ELSE TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(E.CASE_TRMN_YMD, E.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) END AS ENTSC_PRD_YR /*입소기간 - 년*/ , CASE WHEN E.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, E.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) ELSE TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(E.CASE_TRMN_YMD, E.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) END AS ENTSC_PRD_MM /*입소기간 - 월*/ , CASE WHEN E.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, E.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) ELSE TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(E.CASE_TRMN_YMD, E.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) END AS ENTSC_PRD_DD /*입소기간 - 일*/
, C.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , F.SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스제공번호 */ , B.RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ , E.CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */
FROM SEB100 E /* 사례기본 */
JOIN SEB510 A /* 서비스제공대상자 */ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y'
JOIN SEB500 F /* 서비스제공 */ ON F.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND F.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND F.DEL_YN != 'Y'
JOIN SDA100 B /* 자원기본 */ ON B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호
JOIN SAA000 C /* 통합기관 */ ON C.INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO -- 기관번호
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )D ON D.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND D.RN=1
WHERE 1=1 AND E.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} -- 대상자정보번호(입력: TRPR_INFO_NO) AND (C.INST_NO = #{INST_NO}) -- 기관번호(입력: INST_NO) AND B.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY E.CASE_BGNG_YMD

/*selectcrdlsCrtf2 - 이승재 입교수료확인서 등록[디딤, 드림] */
SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO, E.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ , E.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /* 대표전화번호 */ , E.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || E.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /* 사업장 주소 */
, D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 서비스실행사업명 */ , CASE WHEN F.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('01','02') THEN '수료' WHEN F.TRMN_SE_CD IN ('04','11') THEN '미수료' ELSE '입교 중' END AS FNSH_YN /* 수료여부 */ , B.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 사레시작일자 */ , B.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 사례종결일자 */ , CASE WHEN B.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) ELSE TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) END AS ENTSC_PRD_YR /*입소기간 - 년*/ , CASE WHEN B.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) ELSE TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) END AS ENTSC_PRD_MM /*입소기간 - 월*/ , CASE WHEN B.CASE_TRMN_YMD IS NULL THEN TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) ELSE TRUNC(MOD(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12, 1) * (365 / 12)) END AS ENTSC_PRD_DD /*입소기간 - 일*/ , E.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , B.CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */
FROM SEA200 A JOIN SEB100 B ON B.TRPR_INFO_NO = A.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SEB120 C ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND C.DEL_YN != 'Y' JOIN SDA420 D ON C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO JOIN SAA000 E ON D.INST_NO = E.INST_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )F ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND F.RN=1

/*입퇴소확인서 리스트_상세조회 */ SELECT DEC_B64(F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT /*대상자명암호화*/ , F.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /*대상자 출생일자*/ , F.PST_ADDR /*대상자 우편주소*/ , F.DADDR /*대상자 상세주소*/ , F.ZIP /*우편번호*/ , NVL2(F.ZIP, '[' || F.ZIP || ']', '') || F.PST_ADDR || ' ' || F.DADDR AS ADDR /*대상자 우편번호 + 우편주소 + 상세주소*/ , F.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ , G.INST_NM AS INST_NM /*기관명 (발급기관)*/ , G.INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호(발급기관)*/ , G.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO /*대표전화번호*/ , G.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || G.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR /*사업장 우편주소 + 사업장 상세주소*/ , B.INST_NM AS SHELTR_NM /*쉼터명(시설명)*/ , B.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD /*사례시작일시*/ , B.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /*사례종료일시(221216_이승재추가)*/ , TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12) AS ENTSC_PRD_YR /*입소기간 - 년*/ , TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) / 12, 1) * 12) AS ENTSC_PRD_MM /*입소기간 - 월*/ , LEAST(TO_DATE(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD) - ADD_MONTHS(B.CASE_BGNG_YMD, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD, B.CASE_BGNG_YMD))), 29) AS ENTSC_PRD_DD /*입소기간 - 일*/ , A.USE_FSBTY_NM AS USE_FSBTY_NM /*사용용도명*/ , A.USE_FSBTY_NM AS USE_FSBTY_NM /*사용용도명*/ , A.RCPDSK_NM AS RCPDSK_NM /*제출처명*/ , B.ORGNL_CASE_MNG_NO AS ORGNL_CASE_MNG_NO /*원본사례관리번호*/ , B.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ , B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ , A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO AS CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO /*증명서발급관리번호*/ , B.CRTF_ISSU_SN AS CRTF_ISSU_SN /*증명서발급일련번호*/ FROM SAB700 A /* 증명서관리 */ LEFT JOIN SAB701 B /* 증명서관리상세 */ ON A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO = B.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO -- 증명서발급관리번호 LEFT JOIN SEB100 C /* 사례기본 */ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 LEFT JOIN SEA200 F /* 대상자정보 */ ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 LEFT JOIN SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ ON A.ISSU_INST_NO = G.INST_NO -- 기관번호 WHERE 1=1 AND A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO = #{CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO} -- 증명서발급관리번호(입력 : CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO) AND A.CRTF_SE_CD = #{CRTF_SE_CD} -- 증명서구분코드 ORDER BY B.CRTF_ISSU_SN

/* 학업중단 숙려제 실시 결과서 리스트(상세조회) */ SELECT DEC_B64(B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT /* 대상자명 암호화 */ ,( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM -- 공통코드값명 FROM SAC100 -- 공통코드 값 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' -- 공통코드아이디 AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.SXDC_SE_CD -- 공통코드값 AND USE_YN = 'Y' -- 사용여부 ) AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별 */ ,B.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 대상자출생일자 */ ,CONCAT( B.PST_ADDR ,CONCAT(' ',B.DADDR) ) AS ADDR /* 대상자주소 */ ,C.SCHL_NM AS SCHL_NM /* 학교명 */ ,( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM -- 공통코드값명 FROM SAC100 -- 공통코드 값 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' -- 공통코드아이디 AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.GRADE_SE_CD -- 공통코드값 AND USE_YN = 'Y' -- 사용여부 ) AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년 */

,G.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 서비스사업명 */ ,F.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD /* 서비스제공시작일자 */ ,F.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD /* 서비스제공종료일자 */ ,F.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR /* 서비스제공시작시간 */ ,F.SRVC_PVSN_END_HR AS SRVC_PVSN_END_HR /* 서비스제공종료시간 */
,I.SCHULW_DSCNTC_CNSDRA_TRGT_DSCSN_RESULT_SE_CD AS IDNTY_RESULT_SE_CD /* 학업중단숙려대상상담결과구분코드 */ ,H.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN AS YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN /* 청소년변화최종결과내용 */ ,H.PIC_OPNN_CN AS PIC_OPNN_CN /* 담당자의견내용 */ ,I.SCHULW_DSCNTC_CNSDRA_TRGT_END_AFTR_DTL_CN AS SCHULW_DSCNTC_CNSDRA_TRGT_END_AFTR_DTL_CN /* 학업중단숙려대상종료이후상세내용 */
,A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO AS CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO /* 증명서발급관리번호 */ ,A.CRTF_SE_CD AS CRTF_SE_CD /* 증명서구분코드 */ ,A.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ ,A.ISSU_INST_NO AS ISSU_INST_NO /* 발급기관번호 */ ,A.USE_FSBTY_NM AS USE_FSBTY_NM /* 사용용도명 */ ,A.RCPDSK_NM AS RCPDSK_NM /* 제출처명 */ ,A.CTNUTN_ENTRNC_YN AS CTNUTN_ENTRNC_YN /* 연속입소여부 */ ,A.TRPR_REAL_RESDNC_ADDR AS TRPR_REAL_RESDNC_ADDR /* 대상자실제거주지주소 */
,E.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스제공번호 */ ,E.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ ,E.CRTF_ISSU_SN AS CRTF_ISSU_SN /* 증명서발급일련번호 */ ,DEC_B64(B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO /* 대상자전화번호 암호화 */ FROM SAB700 A /* 증명서관리 */ LEFT JOIN SEA200 B /* 대상자정보 */ ON B.TRPR_INFO_NO = A.TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A JOIN SAC100 B ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) C ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = A.TRPR_INFO_NO AND C.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ ON D.INST_NO = A.ISSU_INST_NO -- 기관번호 LEFT JOIN SAB701 E /* 증명서관리상세 */ ON E.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO = A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO -- 증명서발급관리번호 LEFT JOIN SEB500 F /* 서비스제공 */ ON F.SRVC_PVSN_NO = E.SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 AND F.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 AND F.DEL_YN != 'Y' LEFT JOIN SDA100 G /* 자원기본 */ ON G.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, BB.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN, AA.PIC_OPNN_CN ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )H ON H.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND H.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND H.RN=1 LEFT JOIN AKA100 I /* 성관관리 */ ON I.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 AND I.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수

SELECT A.DSCSN_YMD AS DSCSN_YMD, /* 상담일자 */ A.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO, /* 대상자정보번호*/ B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT, /* 대상자명 */ B.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD, /* 생년월일 */ B.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD, /* 성별 */ B.ZIP AS ZIP, /* 우편번호 */ B.PST_ADDR AS PST_ADDR, /* 주소 */ B.DADDR AS DADDR, /* 상세주소 */ B.PST_ADDR || ' ' || DADDR AS ADDR, /* 대상자 주소 + 상세주소 */ C.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM_ENCPT, /* 담당자명 */ D.INST_NM AS INST_NM, /* 기관명 */ D.RPRS_TELNO AS RPRS_TELNO, /* 대표전화번호 */ D.BPLC_ZIP AS BPLC_ZIP, /* 기간우편번호 */ D.BPLC_PST_ADDR AS BPLC_PST_ADDR, /* 기간주소 */ D.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_DADDR, /* 기간상세주소 */ D.BPLC_PST_ADDR || ' ' || D.BPLC_DADDR AS BPLC_ADDR, /* 기간 주소 + 상세주소 */ '전화상담' AS CO13_SE, /* 상담구분_추후 수정예정 */ A.DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN /* 상담내용 */
,A.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */

, '전화상담' AS CO13_SE /*상담구분*/ , DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN /*주요내용*/ , DSCSN_YMD || ' ' || DSCSN_BGNG_HR AS DSCSN_YMD /*상담일시*/
, A.USE_FSBTY_NM /*사용용도명*/ , A.RCPDSK_NM /*제출처명*/ , A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO /*증명서발급관리번호*/
FROM SAB700 A --증명서관리 LEFT JOIN SEA200 B --대상자정보 ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ LEFT JOIN ACA140 C --1388전화상담 ON B.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ LEFT JOIN SAA000 D --통합기관 ON C.INST_NO = D.INST_NO /*기관번호*/
WHERE 1=1 AND A.CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO = #{CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO} /*증명서발급관리번호(입력 : CRTF_ISSU_MNG_NO)*/ AND A.CRTF_SE_CD = #{CRTF_SE_CD} /*증명서구분코드(공통코드에 없음)*/ ORDER BY DSCSN_YMD

/* 담당영역별 담당자명 조회 selectCsemdPicList Lee.Seoung.Jae */ SELECT B.INDIVID_NM AS INDIVID_NM , B.WEEKLY_NM AS WEEKLY_NM , B.ANIGHT_NM AS ANIGHT_NM , B.BNIGHT_NM AS BNIGHT_NM FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , T1.ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD , DEC_B64(T2.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT , T1.TKCG_RELM_SE_CD FROM AFA241 T1 INNER JOIN SCA100 T2 ON T1.PIC_NO = T2.ENFSN_NO)) PIVOT (MAX(FLNM_ENCPT) FOR TKCG_RELM_SE_CD IN ('01' AS INDIVID_NM , '05' AS WEEKLY_NM , '07' AS ANIGHT_NM , '08' AS BNIGHT_NM)) B INNER JOIN SEB120 C ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SEB100 D ON C.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO AND C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND B.ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD = D.ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD WHERE D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U07' AND D.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND D.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}
